name: Nuclear risk
summary: Kim calls for low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons, KCNA says 26 Nov; Trump names an Iranian site he would strike
state: KCNA said on 26 Nov that Kim Jong Un toured two nuclear material plants, called North Korea's nuclear status irreversible and urged low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons (AP via TPR). IAEA chief Grossi said the week before that North Korea is expanding enrichment at Yongbyon. Trump said on 26 Nov the US would hit Iran's Pickaxe Mountain site if strikes resume (Business Standard). No test, alert change or threatened use in a conflict found, so Watch holds.
for_you: No change in official UK guidance. Nuclear rhetoric raises long-term risk but does not on its own signal imminent use.
rubric_hit: Explicit nuclear expansion and doctrine statements = Watch; no test or alert change

sources.title: TPR (AP) — North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
Business Standard — US could hit Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site if strikes resume: Trump

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
